name: Oak Woodlands Conservation Program
summary: Funding for projects that conserve and restore California's oak woodlands, open to conservation organisations, cities, counties and landowners, with applications taken year-round and Board decisions several times a year.

steps: Technical review of the full application

eligibility.rule: Acquisitions are priced at or below appraised fair market value

documents: Full list of assessor parcel numbers, if the project includes more than five

status.quote: While applications are accepted on a year-round basis, the WCB generally meets four times a year.

applicant_types.quote: The Oak Woodlands Conservation Program offers landowners, conservation organizations, cities and counties, an opportunity to obtain funding for projects designed to conserve and restore California's oak woodlands.

geography.quote: projects designed to conserve and restore California's oak woodlands

access.quote: Information about applying for grants can be found on the WCB Grant Opportunities page.

window.quote: While applications are accepted on a year-round basis, the WCB generally meets four times a year.

effort.quote: Applicants will first submit a Pre-application.
WCB staff will select Pre-applications to move forward and will invite the selected applicants to submit Full Applications.
Applicants will first submit a Pre-application. WCB staff review Pre-applications for consistency with WCB goals, any specific program priorities, and the strength of the proposed project.
All eligible and complete Full Applications will be evaluated and scored by technical reviewers, which will include representatives from WCB, CDFW, and others as appropriate.

All applications that comply with the program requirements and meet program eligibility criteria will be scheduled for Board consideration once the real estate due diligence is completed and sufficient money exists to fund the request.

eligibility.quote: WCB only funds acquisitions from willing sellers.
Acquisitions, in the form of conservation easement, water rights, and fee purchases, must be from willing sellers and at a price that does not exceed the fair market value.

co_finance_required.quote: Cost share is not required but may be beneficial, in particular to complete a larger project.

after_award.quote: All grantees doing restoration, development, scientific studies, and planning will be required to provide a final report.
